skills.name: Negative numbers
skills.description: Add, subtract, multiply and divide with negative numbers.
objectives: Add and subtract integers including negatives

skills.name: Order of operations
skills.description: Brackets, powers, multiply and divide, then add and subtract.
objectives: Evaluate expressions in the right order

skills.name: Fraction operations
skills.description: Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions, and simplify.
objectives: Divide by flipping the second fraction

skills.name: One- and two-step equations
skills.description: Solve equations by undoing operations on both sides.
objectives: Use inverse operations on both sides

skills.name: Brackets and variables on both sides
skills.description: Expand brackets, collect x terms on one side, then solve.
objectives: Collect x terms on one side
